claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Canon EOS 600D body and a lens; however 'very neat and sharp' (image sharpness/condition) is not verifiable from photos alone.
Photos show Canon branding and 'EOS 600D' / 'Canon' markings on the camera bodies and lenses (photos 0, 1, 2).

risks.risk: Seller may be mixing items (photos show both EOS 600D and EOS 700D). You might receive the wrong body or only one of them.
risks.proof: Ask: 'Which exact camera am I buying—EOS 600D or EOS 700D? Is it one body or both?' and request a photo of the exact item with the same serial number/label clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case single body you can confirm from the listing photos (EOS 600D) with lens, but treat condition as not guaranteed.

risks.risk: Lens included is unclear for the exact unit you’ll receive (photos show at least one EFS 18-55mm and another lens on the other body).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the included lens(es) attached to the exact body being sold, plus a close-up of lens model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as EOS 600D with the EFS 18-55mm lens only; treat any extra lens as not included.

risks.risk: Functionality (shutter count/AF, buttons, ports, sensor health) cannot be confirmed from these shelf photos.
risks.proof: Request a short video: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a sample photo showing the LCD and a plain wall/sky for dust spots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven fully working; assume typical used-camera faults until tested.

risks.risk: Condition/cleanliness (scratches, dents, missing parts, battery/charger status) is not fully verifiable.
risks.proof: Request close-ups of: lens front element, sensor area (if possible), body corners, and the battery compartment; also show what accessories are included (battery, charger, strap).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown accessories; assume you may need to replace missing items.

proof_requests: Confirm which exact camera you are buying: EOS 600D or EOS 700D (and whether it’s one body or both).
Show the included lens(es) for the exact body (lens model text close-up; lens attached to the body).
Send a video test: power on, menu, autofocus, and a sample photo on a plain background to check sensor dust.
Show included accessories: battery + charger (and any memory card), with clear photos.
response.reason: The photos clearly show Canon EOS 600D and also another Canon body (EOS 700D), while the seller text incorrectly claims Sony. Without confirmation of which exact unit and accessories you’ll receive—and basic functionality tests—a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently applied.
